restaurantName: Khun Jaeng Guay Tiew Pak Mor Kao Wang
address: 246/4 Lang Mueang Road, Nai Mueang, Mueang Khon Kaen, Khon Kaen, 40000, Thailand
bio: This shop peddles perfect rice dumplings and tapioca balls – a skill passed on by the chef's mother, who plied her trade in Bangkok for 30 years. The tangy tom yum soup with egg is a must and the garlic chive dumplings are exceptional....
pageTitle: Khun Jaeng Guay Tiew Pak Mor Kao Wang
